resources.string: Muviss keeps every movie and show you watch — episode by episode, offline, and only on your device. No sign-up, no feed, no ads.
Save titles and tick episodes as you watch. Their status follows what you have actually seen, so you never set it by hand.
The Progress tab lists every show you are part-way through, with its next unseen episode and a one-tap tick.
The home-screen widget puts it one tap away.
Go through titles one at a time and decide in a tap — not for me, later, watching, or caught up — to fill your library fast.
Bring your history from Trakt, TV Time, a CSV file or a Muviss backup.
Get a notification when a show you follow has a new episode. It is off until you turn it on, and you can change it any time in Settings.
Notifications are blocked for Muviss in the system settings, so they cannot be turned on from here.
Muviss gets titles from TMDB using its own key. If you have a TMDB account you can use yours instead. It is optional, and you can change it later in Settings.
Search for a title to start your library.
